alternative_names: Nonadecafluorodecanoic acid, PFNA, Ammonium perfluorononanoate, Sodium perfluorononanoate
app_text: Perfluorononanoic acid (PFNA) is a PFAS (forever chemical) banned in cosmetic products in the EU under Annex II/1636. PFAS chemicals are persistent in the body and environment, and have been associated with reproductive and developmental toxicity.
A PFAS (forever chemical) banned in cosmetic products in the EU under Annex II/1705. PFAS chemicals are persistent in the body and environment with concerns around reproductive and hormonal effects.
Bisphenol S (BPS) is banned in cosmetic products in the EU under Annex II/1702. Like Bisphenol A (BPA), BPS is an endocrine disruptor with concerns around hormonal effects and reproductive health.
Tetrabromobisphenol A (TBBPA) is banned in cosmetic products in the EU under Annex II/1732. It is an endocrine disruptor and suspected reprotoxin found as a contaminant in some cosmetic products.
Methylhydrazine is banned in cosmetic products in the EU under Annex II/1608. It is classified as a carcinogen, mutagen and reprotoxin.

Methylmercury chloride is banned in cosmetic products in the EU under Annex II/1647. Mercury compounds are highly toxic neurotoxins and reprotoxins that can cross the placental barrier and cause serious harm to fetal development.
Tert-Butyl Hydroperoxide is banned in cosmetic products in the EU under Annex II/1641.
1,2-Dichloropropane is banned in cosmetic products in the EU under Annex II/1625. It is classified as a carcinogen.
Dibutyltin dilaurate is banned in cosmetic products in the EU under Annex II/1601. Organotin compounds are reprotoxins with concerns around hormonal disruption and developmental toxicity.
Tetrafluoroethylene is banned in cosmetic products in the EU under Annex II/1681.
Bisphenol AF (BPAF) is banned in cosmetic products in the EU under Annex II/1743. Like BPA and BPS, it is an endocrine disruptor with concerns around reproductive health.
N,N'-Methylenediacrylamide is banned in cosmetic products in the EU under Annex II/1762. It is a neurotoxin and reprotoxin.
